items.title: Refinement of fpqc coverings makes the pullback functor on descent data fully faithful
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For two fpqc coverings of a scheme S with the first a refinement of the second, the lemma shows that pulling descent data back along the refinement is fully faithful, and consequently that schemes over S embed as a full subcategory of the descent data for any fpqc covering (statement lines 9074-9093). The proof introduces the product covering built from the two given ones, notes that it refines both, and uses the resulting two-commutative diagram of categories of descent data whose commutativity is a previous lemma (proof lines 9095-9108). It then reduces to the fully faithfulness of the two legs separately, each of which is the refinement statement for a covering and its refinement (proof lines 9109-9114). The claim is H2: the content is the choice of the intermediate product covering and the reduction to the single-covering case, both written out.
